summary: Iteration 14 — Verified 2-card pricing UX ($159 single + $399 12-month plan), both admin-editable, live-propagated to landing, with scout/agent review baked in. 45/45 backend tests pass (14 new pricing tests + 22 progress_tracking unit + 9 progress_api_live). All required data-testids render on landing + admin Settings. Stripe checkout creates session at the LIVE admin-edited price. Regression: existing scout review on Lukas A. and trajectory page still work perfectly. Prices reset to 159/399 after testing.

verified_features.GET /api/settings/price: Returns {price:159, pass_price:399, currency:'usd', price_dkk:159} — backward-compatible price_dkk alias preserved.
verified_features.PUT /api/admin/price: Admin-only (401 unauth, 403 free), 400 for <=0 or >999, 200 for valid. Update propagates to /settings/price immediately.
verified_features.PUT /api/admin/pass-price: Admin-only (401 unauth, 403 free), 400 for <=0 or >9999, 200 for valid. Update propagates to /settings/price immediately.
verified_features.Pass checkout uses live price: After PUT /admin/pass-price to 449, POST /api/progress/pass/checkout creates Stripe session and payment_transactions row with amount=449 (verified via /api/admin/payments lookup by session_id).
verified_features./admin/agent-queue: Returns list of paid/unlocked reports with non-null agent_review.status ('pending' or 'delivered') for every row. Lukas A. row shows delivered.
verified_features.Landing pricing section: data-testid='pricing-section' renders below hero, with pricing-card-single ($159, ONE FULL REPORT, GET MY REPORT CTA), pricing-card-pass ($399, TRACK THE FULL YEAR, BEST VALUE · SAVE $78 ribbon, $477 strikethrough, START THE 12-MONTH PLAN CTA).
verified_features.Pricing CTAs: Single CTA navigates to /upload (logged-in) or /signup; Pass CTA opens Stripe modal when logged-in or redirects to /login?next=/dashboard&open_pass=1 when not — verified the unauthenticated redirect.
verified_features.Admin Settings tab: Two side-by-side cards: data-testid='admin-price-input' (159) + admin-price-save; admin-pass-price-input (399) + admin-pass-price-save. Both Save buttons issue PUT and show success toast ('12 month plan price updated to $399 USD' was observed).
verified_features.Live propagation: Set admin → single=169, pass=449 → reload landing → cards show $169 / $449. Reset back to 159 / 399; /api/settings/price confirms reset.
/report/64f59196-a520-4ba4-a0f9-de96df8802ef shows data-testid='scout-review-delivered' with the existing 'Elite Scout Team' review text intact.
verified_features.Regression — /trajectory/{Lukas}: Renders trajectory-page with verdict 'AHEAD OF CURVE' (+1.2 pts / +24 pct), growth chart, between-the-lines narrative, pillar deltas (Technical/Tactical/Physical +1.2), mission status with HIT badges, growth badges (First Century, Pro Comparison Unlocked).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/tests/test_progress_api_live.py had a stale hardcoded assertion `amount in (599, 599.0, 59900)` from iter 13 — fixed to assert amount > 0 since the price is now admin-editable.

Consider adding /app/backend/tests/conftest.py with load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env') so the suite works without manual env-setting.
